description: Major food allergen groups used by AIKasya for allergy exclusions. Policy: when unsure, treat an ingredient as containing the allergen; packaged items carry a label-check warning. AIKasya is not a medical device; users with severe allergies must always read product labels.

groups.name: Cereals containing gluten (wheat, rye, barley, oats)
basis: DOH Administrative Order No. 2014-0030 (8 Sep 2014), Revised Rules and Regulations Governing the Labeling of Prepackaged Food Products, Section VI.A.9 - https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/phi174223.pdf
